whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: We are a web application dedicated to organizing Secret Santa groups and creating a social network around this activity. Our mission is to facilitate the organization of gift exchanges in a fun and secure way.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile phone) when you visit a website. Cookies allow the website to recognize your device and store some information about your preferences or past actions.
whatAreCookies.types: There are different types of cookies: session cookies (temporary, deleted when you close the browser) and persistent cookies (remain on your device until they expire or are deleted).

necessary.title: Necessary Cookies
necessary.description: These cookies are strictly necessary for the website to function. They allow you to navigate the website and use essential features, such as secure areas and shopping carts. These cookies cannot be disabled.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies allow the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalization. They may be set by us or by external providers whose services we have added to our pages.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the website by providing information about areas visited, time spent on the site, and issues encountered. This information helps us improve the website's performance.

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.description: These cookies are used to track visitors across different websites. The purpose is to display relevant and engaging ads for the individual user and, therefore, more valuable for third-party publishers and advertisers.

csrftoken.purpose: Protection against CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) attacks

managePreferences.title: How You Can Manage Your Preferences
managePreferences.description: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time using the button below or through the 'Cookie Settings' link available in the application footer.
managePreferences.browser: You can also manage cookies directly in your browser. Most browsers allow you to refuse or accept cookies, as well as delete existing cookies. Check your browser's instructions for more information.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis and GDPR
legalBasis.description: Strictly necessary cookies are used based on our legitimate interest in ensuring the secure and efficient operation of the website. Other cookies (functional, analytics, and marketing) are used only with your explicit consent, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the ePrivacy Directive.
legalBasis.withdraw: You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

rights.title: Data Subject Rights
rights.description: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
rights.access: Right of access - you can request information about the personal data we process
rights.rectification: Right to rectification - you can request correction of incorrect data
rights.erasure: Right to erasure - you can request deletion of your personal data
rights.limit: Right to restriction of processing - you can request limitation of processing of your data
rights.oppose: Right to object - you can object to the processing of your personal data
rights.portability: Right to data portability - you can request transfer of your data to another controller
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.description: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We recommend that you review this page regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies.
